name: Multi-Tier Matte Black Kitchen Spice & Utensil Rack

Finished in rust-resistant matte black powder coating with anti-slip rubber feet and a deep bottom basket for spice jars, oils, whisks, and everyday utensils.
highlights: Dual tier storage with specialized condiment shelf
Easy 5-minute assembly with all tools included

name: Borosilicate Glass Oil & Vinegar Dispenser Set (2-Piece)
description: Transform your cooking counter with this pair of 500ml ultra-clear borosilicate glass dispenser bottles. Features food-grade stainless steel pourers with drip-free flip caps and natural bamboo collars to prevent messy counter drips while maintaining airtight freshness.
highlights: Precision controlled pour spout prevents drips
Includes waterproof custom oil & vinegar labels

name: Sculptural Fluted Ceramic Flora Table Vase
description: A striking statement piece designed for dining tables, entryway consoles, and modern living shelves. Features an elegant architectural fluted ribbed texture crafted from unglazed matte ceramic in warm natural sand tone, perfect for dried florals or fresh botanicals.
highlights: Glazed waterproof interior for fresh cut flowers
